text_block_list.text: Summer camp is now over with Meisho Doto having completed numerous trials in her search for ambition. The result of her endeavor…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uugh, I'm so sorry about this…
…Is rather mute, despite our attempts to toughen her up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um… I don't think I have it in me to push past my competition…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll have to study! I'll use this autumn to prepare… for the eventual future.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I can't prove it, but I think things will be okay if I follow Opera O and Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O is always confident, and Ayabe is always looking far ahead…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Those two are amazing, always making the right decisions. If I think of them as my mentors, then just maybe…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes! I believe it will—because those two are very dear to me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could you… believe in my choice too? For me? Um, even just a little bit is fine…
choice_data_list: All right, I'll believe in your decision.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course! Those who choose to believe in me will never suffer! Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: As long as you don't get in my way, I won't stop you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Opera O, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I just know if I follow you two… I'll…
The ceiling that hampers Meisho Doto's growth is as heavy as ever. But this autumn… hopefully, her peers will show her what it means to compete.
